caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical metal lantern with a conical top, shown standing upright on a light, neutral background. The lantern is gray with a darker tone used for shadowing and details, and it features a pattern of small perforations arranged in radiating and circular designs on its cylindrical body and door. The door of the lantern is hinged on the right and is depicted open, revealing the interior. Inside, there is a brown, partially melted candle standing upright in the center. The lantern has a latch mechanism on the door to the left and a looped handle on top. The artist's signature, "A. Hauglund," is located in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Tin Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
